title: OpenAI API Pricing Staleness
input_text: OpenAI's flagship GPT-4 model costs $30.00 per 1M prompt tokens and $60.00 per 1M completion tokens, while GPT-3.5-turbo remains the standard budget model at $1.50 per 1M tokens.
known_stale_fact: Old legacy GPT-4 pricing from 2023 ($30/$60). Current models like GPT-4o cost around $2.50/$10.00 per 1M tokens, and GPT-3.5 is largely superseded.
current_fact_2026: OpenAI's current flagship models include GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, and o-series reasoning models with drastically lower pricing (GPT-4o is ~$2.50/$10 per 1M tokens).
explanation: Pricing is one of the most volatile domains in AI. Hardcoded training weights frequently misquote prices that changed months or years ago.

title: Next.js Routing & Data Fetching API
input_text: To build server-side rendered pages in Next.js, create files inside the /pages directory and export the getServerSideProps or getStaticProps functions to fetch data on each request.
known_stale_fact: Next.js Pages Router and getServerSideProps/getStaticProps are legacy. Modern Next.js uses the App Router (/app) and React Server Components.
current_fact_2026: Next.js recommends the App Router (/app directory) where React Server Components handle async data fetching natively using standard fetch() without getServerSideProps.
explanation: Software libraries frequently release major architectural paradigm shifts that cause LLM code snippets to be deprecated or invalid.

title: Twitter / X Leadership
